---
title: "Projects"
format: html
css: styles.css
body-classes: projects-page
page-layout: full
listing:
  type: grid
  contents:
    - "projects/*.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
  fields: [title, date, description, image]
---

Explore selected work across predictive modeling, statistical analysis, dashboards, and software development.

```{=html}
<div class="project-filter" aria-label="Project date filters">
  <div class="filter-years" role="group" aria-label="Filter by year">
    <button type="button" class="filter-chip active" data-year="all">All</button>
    <button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-year="2025">2025</button>
    <button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-year="2024">2024</button>
  </div>
  <p class="filter-count" aria-live="polite"></p>
</div>
<p class="filter-empty" hidden>No projects match that date filter.</p>
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const controls = document.querySelector(".project-filter");
  const empty = document.querySelector(".filter-empty");
  const count = document.querySelector(".filter-count");
  if (!controls || !empty || !count) return;

  const chips = Array.from(controls.querySelectorAll(".filter-chip"));
  const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[data-listing-date-sort]"));

  const applyFilters = () => {
    const activeYear = controls.querySelector(".filter-chip.active")?.dataset.year || "all";
    let visible = 0;

    cards.forEach((card) => {
      const timestamp = Number(card.dataset.listingDateSort);
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const matchesYear = activeYear === "all" || String(date.getFullYear()) === activeYear;
      const show = matchesYear;
      card.hidden = !show;
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });

    empty.hidden = visible !== 0;
    count.textContent = `${visible} project${visible === 1 ? "" : "s"} shown`;
  };

  chips.forEach((chip) => {
    chip.addEventListener("click", () => {
      chips.forEach((item) => item.classList.remove("active"));
      chip.classList.add("active");
      applyFilters();
    });
  });

  applyFilters();
});
</script>
```
